integrity: The closed form is derived analytically from the source fixed-resolution variational formula and an exact Pauli-channel decomposition. A finite checker only corroborates algebraic identities and series coefficients; no numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the identity null hypothesis and equal-rate qubit generalized amplitude damping in the discrimination model of arXiv:2610.03629v1. It is an asymptotic exposure-time statement, not an exact finite-time error formula, and it does not cover unequal transition rates.
title: Exact resolution profile for equal-rate generalized amplitude damping discrimination
